title: a16z Podcast: Innovation vs. Invention at Google I/O

reader_summary.headline: Hi, everyone, welcome to the A6NZ podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi, everyone, welcome to the A6NZ podcast. Today, we're sharing some quick reactions to Google IO. A16D deal investing partner, Kyle Russell, discusses the news with A16Z's Benedict Evans, Connie Chan, and board partner Steven Sinovsky. So, Stephen, yesterday, Google announced quite a few different products and services.

thesis: The speakers argue that Google I/O demonstrated a coherent shift toward artificial intelligence as the next generation of platform, moving from reactive search to anticipatory automation of daily life. They contend that while these innovations feel incremental rather than like sudden inventions, they represent substantial leaps in automating living by leveraging Google's data and computer vision strengths.
